findings.claim: The old Step 5 loop (run evidence.sh check, fix rows) is replaced by a self-check list that omits rules check enforces: no repeated kind (evidence.sh:113), a rule for level >= 2 (evidence.sh:117), every Evidence kind has a Kinds row (evidence.sh:148). Two findings mapping to one new kind, or a Kinds row for an existing kind, make the parent check in T4b fail, restore the page and leave the result unclassified; nothing returns the failure to the classifier.

Exported ClaudeInstructions, documented as the exact inverse of the Claude file, requires name: right after ---; claudeFile now writes notice comments there, so it rejects agents/classifier.md. Its test covers only the eight roles. No production caller today.

The read-only restriction rests only on tools: Read, Grep, Glob in a frontmatter that now starts with 23 YAML comment lines no generated agent had before; nothing shows Claude Code loads this file and applies the restricted tools.
PROVENANCE quotes "You receive the findings the review kept", wording the body no longer has (body.md:10).
A notice that cannot be read is named after noticePath but Check reports it as the role source missing or unreadable (agentgen.go:230-233); messages_pin_test.go:237 pins the misleading text.
role.notice works only for claudeOnlyRoles; project passes an empty license and build never reads notice for chain roles or the foreman, so a notice set there is silently dropped.
noticeComments hard-codes andresfrei/playbook and the MIT License; a second role with another origin or licence would get a false attribution line.
With no fences, the Fatalf argument fences[len(fences)-1] panics before the message, aborting the shelltest binary.
Output asks for one markdown fence without naming the opener; L47 and T4b parsing expect a markdown-tagged fence.
The body defines the stop for a missing page or rules and empty for an empty index, but nothing for a missing index.
